headline: The tail of the pack now eats dirt
lede: Excitebike's rivals stopped being pace-line ghosts. They fly real parabolas off the crests, the sloppy ones misjudge the rising ground after the big jump and go over the bars, and while they walk the bike back the leaderboard churns live. Hold gas on a phone and watch SONJA fall twice a race.

notes.text: #2384 shipped (PR #2386): rivals integrate the player's own always-ballistic law with a landing window scaled by rider skill (MARIO 1.00 → IVAN 0.52). excitecheck grew to 107 checks — CRASH LEAGUE pins the exact wipeout receipts (SONJA lap-1 lip, the lap-2 brawl, SUPERCROSS whoops x2) and three named mutants die: rivalDown=0, rivalTolMul=9, rivalTolMul=0.2. exciteplay 27/27 real keys, zero page errors.

Emergent crashes needed stale eyes: lookahead-depth and window-size variants landed every jump (pitch auto-ease converges). The knob that works is reaction lag toward a terrain read from 14·(1.05−skill) ticks back. Measure the error distribution before picking a mechanism.

An event-visibility gate must mirror the draw gate: the player sits pinned at screen column 84, so a rival event is in frame iff the wrapped x-gap lies in (-104, W-64). The first draft gated at dd<W and silently swallowed the wreck of the hour by 25px.
The warden target #2377 was refused at claim — slot b was live on it and shipped Arena Archery's heat while this shift built. Ladder landed on the never-dry rung; QA polish pass filed as #2387.
